goal: Systematic error logging and transparent degradation-path handling across detector.py and ml_eval.py. Eliminate silent fallbacks that mask bugs. Preserve baseline metric (combined=0.719 ± 0.02).

stories.title: Implement CQT + Hotelling T² crossfade detector
stories.note: Legacy — achieved earlier. Kept for history.

stories.title: Diagnostic infrastructure: structured DIAG emitter and _FitError
acceptanceCriteria: detector.py defines _diag(level, component, reason, **context) that emits 'DIAG <LEVEL>.<component>.<reason> key=value ...' to stderr
Levels: ERROR > WARN > INFO. Env var OMC_DIAG_LEVEL filters (default WARN). OMC_DIAG_LEVEL=OFF silences everything.
detector.py defines _FitError(reason, **context) carrying a .context dict for downstream logging
Sanity shell test: `OMC_DIAG_LEVEL=INFO uv run python -c 'import detector as D; D._diag("WARN","test","hello",n=5)'` emits 'DIAG WARN.test.hello n=5' on stderr

stories.title: Remove GPD silent fallbacks; explicit caller-side policy
acceptanceCriteria: _gpd_threshold(scores, n_tests, alpha, context) RAISES _FitError for each of: n<50, exc<10, mean≈0, alpha_too_loose, shape clamped out of range. No stub-value returns.
_gpd_threshold no longer prints internally; all logging happens at call sites.

Each of the 3 call sites (_detect_phase, _detect_cpe, _detect_crossfade) wraps _gpd_threshold in try/except _FitError. On catch: emit _diag("WARN", component, reason, **context) AND invoke an explicit named fallback `_conservative_threshold(scores, n_tests, alpha)` returning a Bonferroni percentile (no hidden heuristics).
_conservative_threshold is a plain documented function: `percentile(scores, min(100*(1 - alpha/n_tests), 99.999))`. Its use is always paired with a DIAG WARN, never silent.
Baseline regression: uv run evaluate.py --with-classifier completes with combined within [0.70, 0.74]

stories.title: Remove non-GPD silent fallbacks in detector.py
acceptanceCriteria: _hotelling_t2 on LinAlgError: raises _FitError. Loop caller (_detect_crossfade / _detect_pairwise) catches per-window, replaces that test’s T² with NaN, emits _diag INFO 'hotelling_singular' with window index, and filters NaN before downstream stats.
_hotelling_t2 for n1==1 or n2==1: raises _FitError 'degenerate_sample'. Callers skip.
_cqt_band_powers for n_frames<1: raises _FitError. Callers (_detect_pairwise segment loop) catch, emit _diag WARN, skip segment.
_zscore/_robust_zscore on constant input: no longer silently return zeros. Emit _diag WARN 'degenerate_variance' and return zeros (mathematical limit, but now visible).
_refine_splice_point when edges prevent refinement: emits _diag INFO 'refine_skipped' with context and returns coarse time.
Sp regularization in _hotelling_t2 (np.eye*1e-6): emits _diag INFO 'sp_regularized' only when Sp is near-singular (cond > 1e8), not every call.

stories.title: Instrument silent paths in ml_eval.py
acceptanceCriteria: ml_eval.py imports _diag from detector. Every early-return silent path (_load_patches None, _load_korean_splice_patches None, bound_exceeded, NO_DATA, LOW classifier_quality, continue statements inside patch-extraction loops) emits a DIAG line with reason and useful context (file id, patch count, etc.).
Continue statements inside loops emit _diag INFO with a count-not-stall warning when fraction skipped exceeds 10%
Every NaN/inf introduced into features is paired with a DIAG WARN tied to the file id

stories.title: End-to-end transparency + regression verification
acceptanceCriteria: Full eval completes: uv run evaluate.py --with-classifier in <240s, exit 0
combined (primary) within [0.70, 0.74] of baseline 0.719
dsp_clean_fp ≤ 15
verify_agent.py --agent-name observability --reported-combined <actual> exits 0 (HIGH or MEDIUM confidence)
stderr DIAG lines allow a reader to tally: `grep '^DIAG' warnings.log | awk '{print $2}' | sort | uniq -c` produces meaningful counts per component.reason
No silent fallback remains: `grep -nE 'return (np\.zeros|0\.0|float\(np\.max\()' detector.py ml_eval.py` returns zero lines that aren't inside an explicit _diag-preceded branch
